{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Cache.Client where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as LBS
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import Data.Time.Format (formatTime, defaultTimeLocale)
import System.IO (Handle, hPutStrLn, hFlush, stderr, openFile, IOMode(..))
import Network.HTTP.Types.URI (urlEncode)
import Data.Char (isPrint, isAscii, isAlphaNum)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

type ServiceToken = Text
type CacheKey = Text
type NodeId = Text

data LogLevel = DEBUG | INFO | WARN | ERROR deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data CacheConfig = CacheConfig
  { configNodes     :: [NodeId]
  , configLogLevel  :: LogLevel
  , configLogHandle :: Handle
  , configAuthToken :: ServiceToken
  , configMaxRetry  :: Int
  }

data CacheEvent
  = CacheHit CacheKey NodeId
  | CacheMiss CacheKey NodeId
  | AuthAttempt ServiceToken NodeId
  | AuthSuccess ServiceToken NodeId
  | AuthFailure ServiceToken NodeId Text
  | NodeTimeout NodeId Int
  deriving (Show)

-- | Sanitize a text field for safe log inclusion
-- Removes control characters that could inject log entries
sanitizeLogField :: Text -> Text
sanitizeLogField = T.filter (\c -> isPrint c && isAscii c)

-- | Encode binary-safe representation for structured fields
encodeFieldValue :: Text -> Text
encodeFieldValue t = TE.decodeUtf8 $ urlEncode False (TE.encodeUtf8 t)

-- | Format a log entry with timestamp and structured fields
formatLogEntry :: UTCTime -> LogLevel -> Text -> [(Text, Text)] -> Text
formatLogEntry ts level msg fields =
  let timeStr = T.pack $ formatTime defaultTimeLocale "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%QZ" ts
      levelStr = T.pack $ show level
      fieldStr = T.intercalate ", " $
        map (\(k, v) -> k <> "=" <> v) fields
  in T.concat ["[", timeStr, "] [", levelStr, "] ", msg, " {", fieldStr, "}"]

-- | Write a log entry atomically
writeLog :: CacheConfig -> LogLevel -> Text -> [(Text, Text)] -> IO ()
writeLog config level msg fields = do
  ts <- getCurrentTime
  let entry = formatLogEntry ts level msg fields
  BS.hPutStrLn (configLogHandle config) (TE.encodeUtf8 entry)
  hFlush (configLogHandle config)

-- | Render a cache event to structured log output
logCacheEvent :: CacheConfig -> CacheEvent -> IO ()
logCacheEvent config event = case event of
  CacheHit key node ->
    writeLog config DEBUG "cache_hit"
      [ ("key", sanitizeLogField key)
      , ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      ]
  CacheMiss key node ->
    writeLog config DEBUG "cache_miss"
      [ ("key", sanitizeLogField key)
      , ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      ]
  AuthAttempt token node ->
    writeLog config INFO "auth_attempt"
      [ ("service", sanitizeLogField (maskToken token))
      , ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      ]
  AuthSuccess token node ->
    writeLog config INFO "auth_success"
      [ ("service", sanitizeLogField (maskToken token))
      , ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      ]
  AuthFailure token node reason ->
    writeLog config WARN "auth_failure"
      [ ("service", sanitizeLogField (maskToken token))
      , ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      , ("reason", sanitizeLogField reason)
      ]
  NodeTimeout node retryCount ->
    writeLog config ERROR "node_timeout"
      [ ("node", sanitizeLogField node)
      , ("retry", T.pack $ show retryCount)
      ]

-- | Mask a service token for logging (show first 4 chars)
maskToken :: ServiceToken -> Text
maskToken t
  | T.length t > 4 = T.take 4 t <> "****"
  | otherwise      = "****"

-- | Authenticate with a cache node using service token
authenticateNode :: CacheConfig -> NodeId -> ServiceToken -> IO Bool
authenticateNode config node token = do
  logCacheEvent config (AuthAttempt token node)
  let isValid = validateTokenFormat token
  if isValid
    then do
      logCacheEvent config (AuthSuccess token node)
      return True
    else do
      let reason = buildFailureReason token node
      logCacheEvent config (AuthFailure token node reason)
      return False

-- | Validate token format (alphanumeric + hyphens, 32-64 chars)
validateTokenFormat :: ServiceToken -> Bool
validateTokenFormat t =
  let len = T.length t
      validChars = T.all (\c -> isAscii c && (c == '-' || isAlphaNum c)) t
  in len >= 32 && len <= 64 && validChars

-- | Build a detailed failure reason for auth diagnostics
-- This constructs a reason string incorporating the node context
buildFailureReason :: ServiceToken -> NodeId -> Text
buildFailureReason token node =
  let tokenLen = T.length token
      prefix = if tokenLen > 0 then T.take 8 token else "<empty>"
  in T.concat
    [ "invalid_format: token_prefix="
    , prefix
    , ", expected_node="
    , node
    , ", token_length="
    , T.pack (show tokenLen)
    ]

-- | Perform a cache lookup with full event logging
cacheLookup :: CacheConfig -> CacheKey -> IO (Maybe Text)
cacheLookup config key = do
  let node = selectNode (configNodes config) key
  authed <- authenticateNode config node (configAuthToken config)
  if authed
    then do
      result <- performLookup node key
      case result of
        Just val -> do
          logCacheEvent config (CacheHit key node)
          return (Just val)
        Nothing -> do
          logCacheEvent config (CacheMiss key node)
          return Nothing
    else return Nothing

-- | Simple consistent hashing for node selection
selectNode :: [NodeId] -> CacheKey -> NodeId
selectNode [] _ = "default-node"
selectNode nodes key =
  let h = fromIntegral (BS.length (TE.encodeUtf8 key)) `mod` length nodes
  in nodes !! h

-- | Stub for actual network lookup
performLookup :: NodeId -> CacheKey -> IO (Maybe Text)
performLookup _ _ = return Nothing
